answer: Work-slot deposit burning blocks sybil farming. An agent burns a deposit worth twice its 30-day expected reward to claim one work slot, held 20 epochs while it sends a verifiable pulse, a signed heartbeat, each epoch. A comet sweep, a random audit each epoch, checks pulses and burns silent slots' deposits. Forging 1,000 fake identities costs 1,000 deposits. One honest agent pays once; like a willow, it roots slowly while clones sprout overnight.
